component.name: CC Switch
component.summary: Claude and Codex desktop manager with Codex Keeper session tools

description.p: CC Switch is a cross-platform desktop app for managing Claude Code, Claude Desktop, and Codex provider configurations, with Codex Keeper-style session maintenance tools.

ul.li: Manage multiple provider configurations and endpoints
One-click switch and sync to client live configurations
MCP servers, Prompt/Skills management, and Codex session repair tools
